profile.headline: Software Developer | Head of Composition | Artist Faculty | Roosevelt University
profile.summary:
Multifaceted musician with extensive experience in composing, performing, recording, programming, transcribing, arranging, writing and teaching.

Specialties: modern classical music, microtonality, stringed instruments, computer music, Brazilian jazz.
